selection.q: How do you select featured brands?
selection.a: Licensing, payout speed, payment coverage, and partner responsiveness each carry a score. Sponsored placement never overrides the base rating.

onboarding.a: Yes. We onboard new affiliates, but expect to see traffic plans and respect for responsible gaming guidelines.

support.a: Every priority partner receives a dedicated account manager plus access to our shared strategy Slack.

markets.a: CEE and LatAm funnels are strongest this quarter, but we share fresh cohort data once you connect with the team.
